entries.en: Added /config toggle to enable/disable prompt suggestions
entries.zh: 添加了 /config 开关以启用/禁用提示建议

entries.en: Added `/settings` as an alias for the `/config` command
entries.zh: 添加了`/settings`作为`/config`命令的别名

entries.en: New syntax highlighting engine for native build
entries.zh: 原生构建版采用全新的语法高亮引擎

entries.en: Fixed @ file reference suggestions incorrectly triggering when cursor is in the middle of a path
entries.zh: 修复了当光标位于路径中间时错误触发的@文件引用建议

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers from `.mcp.json` not loading when using `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`--dangerously-skip-permissions`时未加载`.mcp.json`中的 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed permission rules incorrectly rejecting valid bash commands containing shell glob patterns (e.g., `ls *.txt`, `for f in *.png`)
entries.zh: 修复了权限规则错误地拒绝包含 shell glob 模式的有效 bash 命令（例如，`ls *.txt`、`for f in *.png`）

entries.en: Bedrock: Environment variable `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is now respected for token counting and inference profile listing
entries.zh: Bedrock：环境变量`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL`现在受到令牌计数和推理配置文件列表的尊重
